chapter.title: System calls
chapter.para: Partitions use the services of the kernel through system calls. Each is identified by a number and passes its arguments in a structure in the memory of the partition.

section.para: JetOS shall provide the system calls that are listed in the chapters of this document: the services of processes, critical sections, time, ports, partitions, health monitoring, memory blocks and the console, each one when the module is built to use it.

formalpara.title: Rationale
formalpara.para: The system calls are the interface between the partitions and the kernel.

section.para: JetOS shall accept a system call on x86_64 from a software interrupt and on arm64 from the supervisor call instruction, with the identifier of the call and the address of its arguments in registers.

formalpara.title: Rationale
formalpara.para: The two architectures differ in the instruction, not in the service.

formalpara.title: Traceability
formalpara.para: HLR_EXCEPTIONS_JA_EXCEPTION_SYNC_USER_01 HLR_SYSCALLS_ARM64_PROCESS_SYSCALL_01 HLR_SYSCALL_POK_CORE_SYSCALL_01 HLR_INTERRUPT_IDT_SET_GATE_01 HLR_INTERRUPT_JA_IDT_INIT_01 HLR_INTERRUPT_JA_INTERRUPT_HANDLER_01 HLR_SYSCALLS_X86_64_PROCESS_SYSCALL_01

section.para: JetOS shall return the result of a system call to the caller in a register.

formalpara.title: Rationale
formalpara.para: The two architectures differ in the instruction, not in the service.

section.para: JetOS shall return a result to the caller that tells whether the call succeeded or why it failed.

formalpara.title: Rationale
formalpara.para: Applications need to see the reason for an error.

section.para: JetOS shall treat a system call with an unknown identifier as an illegal request error of the calling partition.

formalpara.title: Rationale
formalpara.para: A faulty partition must not harm the module.

section.para: JetOS shall check the arguments of a system call that are addresses, identifiers, names, sizes and modes before it uses them, and refuse a bad one with an error.

formalpara.title: Rationale
formalpara.para: A partition must not make the kernel misbehave with bad arguments.

section.para: JetOS shall run a system call with preemption enabled, except for the code that must not be interrupted, so that the time that the kernel needs for a call does not delay an interrupt for long.

formalpara.title: Rationale
formalpara.para: The response of the module to the timer must stay short.

section.para: JetOS shall, when it returns from a system call or from an interrupt to a partition, first handle the events that the partition has, and restore the state of the floating point unit of the process that returns.

formalpara.title: Rationale
formalpara.para: The partition has to see what happened while it was in the kernel.

section.para: JetOS shall, when it is built to give partitions access to input and output ports (x86_64 only), let a partition read and write the ports in the range that the configuration gives to it, and refuse any other port with a not-permitted error.

formalpara.title: Rationale
formalpara.para: A partition may drive a device only if it is given the ports of that device.
